positions.name: RollbackOperationalReality
positions.frame: what operational practice makes a rollback real?
positions.why: src-1 directs monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals as operational practice; src-2 articulates the principle that an unrehearsed rollback is not a real rollback. Both cohere under the question of what constitutes genuine rollback capability — the directive and its underlying principle read in the same direction.

positions.name: RollbackCadenceParameter
positions.frame: what cadence does the session set for rollback rehearsals?
positions.why: src-3 names 'Cadence' and src-4 specifies 'monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals' — both are session-level annotations characterizing the cadence dimension of the decision, cohering under the question of what temporal rhythm the session frames for rehearsals.

positions.name: RollbackDecisionOwner
positions.frame: who owns the rollback rehearsal decision?
positions.why: src-5 names 'Owner' and src-6 names 'Quinton Fairweather' — both are session-level annotations attributing ownership of the decision, cohering under the question of who the decision owner is.
